settings.heading: We're here to help
settings.text: Questions about a piece, an order or delivery to your country.

settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Orders are processed within 5 to 10 business days, then sent by tracked post. Delivery to most countries usually takes 2 to 4 weeks.

settings.question: Which countries do you deliver to?
settings.answer: We ship to most countries. Choose your country at the top of the page to see prices in your currency; delivery options and costs are shown at checkout.

settings.question: Are duties and taxes included?
settings.answer: No. Any customs duties or taxes charged by your country are paid by you.
